description: This file defines the UserEntity class implementing the UserEntityInterface for OAuth2, representing a user entity in the OAuth context, with methods for creation from a User object and retrieving the identifier.

classes.name: UserEntity
classes.description: A class implementing OAuth2 UserEntityInterface to represent a user in OAuth2 authentication workflows.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the UserEntity with a user identifier.

methods.name: createFromEntity
methods.description: Creates a UserEntity instance from an existing User entity object.
